description: Observed state of one item, written by a host agent to <state-dir>/<kind>/<name>.json and read by prov status.

agent_version.description: Version of the agent that wrote the record.

applied_rev.description: Commit of the infrastructure repository the host last applied (lowercase hex).

drift.description: Whether the running host still matches what it applied.

detail.description: Free text for a human; never parsed.

status.description: clean, drifted or unknown (the agent cannot tell).

facts.description: Backend-specific facts about the host (hardware, disks, network); free-form.

generation.description: Backend-specific generation of the running system (e.g. a NixOS system generation).

last_seen.description: When the agent last reported, RFC 3339 with a Z or a numeric offset.

ref.description: The item this record observes, <kind>/<name>; equals the record's path.

render_digest.description: prov digest of the rendered/ tree the host last applied.

title: prov state record v1alpha1
